rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - T35RMGF

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TC7DXUJ

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops

* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut

HVAC

* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet

* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

as for what caused this issue? I could say with upmost certainty that I did not start this infestation problem… this problem, this infestation has become so extreme ONLY because it has been overlooked ignored and not taking seriously by management.

- Reports moderate amount of pests

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - T33L8MQ

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TMYBZ4F

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem

* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn

* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - T1B3RU8

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - T1WPE24

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

D - Maintenance - T2UP8LC

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TPHLGHEB

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

D - Maintenance - TU9M1MMB

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TJ5982G

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TBEMBTF

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

D - Maintenance - TXZ9UI1

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet

* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem

* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later

* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TEXY83LB

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass

* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TZV4R0I

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - T2TUWGV

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TH9DD4E

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
B -2 - Determine Source Unit - TGJ7W62

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem

* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured

* Verify window locks operate properly

* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Determine what units/s causing infestation and/or are non-compliant.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.service_request_description:
D - Maintenance - TW8V4F7

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

rows.job_description:
Irrigation Winterization - T66CQ2E

Upload photos directly onto the property meld app (before and after)
Blow out the irrigation lines before the first freeze:
1. Shut off the main irrigation water supply and set the controller to off/rain mode.
2. Connect the air compressor at the blowout port after the backflow preventer. Keep air pressure at 50 psi or less (80 psi max on PVC).
3. Open one zone at a time from the controller and blow air until only mist comes out of the heads (about 2 minutes per zone). Go through all zones twice. Never run air with all zones closed.
4. Disconnect the compressor and open the drain valves and backflow test cocks so any water left can drain.
5. Insulate or cover the backflow preventer and any exposed pipes.
6. Note any broken heads, leaks or damaged valves in the meld.

Pest Service Documentation Requirements for Vendors

When servicing any unit for pest-related issues, vendors must follow these documentation standards:

1. Photographs (Required)

Provide clear, time-stamped photos of:

A. Pest Evidence

Live/dead bugs, nests, droppings, egg casings, entry points.

B. Contributing Housekeeping Conditions

Pots/pans or food left out

Exposed food or open pantry items

Accessible pet food

Greasy surfaces

Damp/wet areas

Excess clutter

Cardboard boxes (especially food boxes)

Trash or unsanitary conditions

Photos must clearly show conditions that may contribute to pest activity.

2. Tenant Statements

Document any tenant admissions regarding:

Knowledge of pests

Length of infestation

Contributing conditions

Delayed reporting

Include date, unit number, and exact statement (no interpretation).

3. Source Identification

If identifying a unit as a source, vendors must:

Provide specific supporting conditions

Include photographic evidence

Explain the reasoning (not just number of bugs observed)

4. Multiple Affected Units

When several units are impacted:

Evaluate the possibility of multiple contributing sources

Identify and document each contributing unit

Management may charge any apartment determined to be a contributor.

D - Maintenance - TNQQM5Z

Repairs as notated by Supervisor to Include:

Doors
* Evaluate doors to make sure they aren't damaged and also check if they need weather stripping or painting
* Verify that doors open and close easily and seal completely when closed

Appliances
* Verify that refrigerator is cooling
* Verify freezer temperature is below 16 degrees F
* Verify refrigerator door gasket seals
* Verify oven, broiler and each of the top burners on stove heat
* Verify vent hood is operational
* Verify disposal is functional and not blocked
* Run the dishwasher through a complete cycle and verify no water is leaking

Kitchen
* Verify kitchen faucet has no leaks near the spout or stem
* Verify no leaks in drain piping under the sink 
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn 
* Verify kitchen cabinets and drawers open and shut easily and that they stay shut
* Verify hot water comes out of the faucet


Bathroom
* Verify faucets don’t leak near spout or stem
* Verify no excessive chips or damage to countertops
* Check drain lines for weak areas that might leak later
* Verify caulking on the countertop is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify toilets flush, drain, and refill properly and don’t run
* Verify caulking around the tub/shower is not cracked or excessively worn
* Verify tub holds water and drains properly
* Verify doors on shower/tub operate properly
* Verify shower curtain rod is present and secured properly 
* Verify shower head sprays normally and doesn't leak near head or stem

HVAC
* Verify heating and cooling function properly

Interior
* Check for broken or cracked glass
* Verify windows have screens and are secured
* Verify windows open and close without excessive force
* Verify window locks operate properly
* Verify all lights and switches operate properly
* Verify electric cover plates are not broken or missing
